total_model.summary: Model projects 47.2 total points (NYG 26, NO 21). Biggest factors: Combined rush defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 0.9), Combined offense EPA/play (recent-weighted) (raises total 0.8), Combined quarterback ratings (lowers total 0.7). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
